our_interpretation: The concrete assertion concerns Anysphere, the company operating Cursor, making substantial overall losses relative to revenue.

Gross margin, cash burn and net income are distinct measures; none will silently substitute for another.
The supplied passage gives no accounting basis for the profitability assertion. The nearby revenue figures do not establish one.
The sector-wide implication supplies neither a measurable outcome nor a deadline and is not separately scored as a forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Period-matched financial evidence on an identified basis shows substantial company-wide losses relative to revenue, with a basis that can be matched to the claim.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable financial evidence shows company-wide profitability, or losses clearly too small to sustain the ordinary description of substantial unprofitability.
